description: Two oscillators, Castor and Pollux, each mixing a ramp, a pulse and a sub-octave square, plus a modulating oscillator routed by a four-way mode knob; after Winterbloom's Castor & Pollux

params.text: Sets Castor's pitch: three octaves either way in semitone steps while the Castor pitch input is empty, and a continuous offset of up to one octave either way added to that input once a cable is in it
Offsets Pollux's pitch by up to one octave either way; in Hard Sync mode it sets how far above the sync source Pollux runs instead, none at fully counter-clockwise up to three octaves fully clockwise
Sets the rate of the modulating oscillator, 64Hz at fully counter-clockwise rising to 2048Hz at fully clockwise; in Hard Sync mode nothing reads that oscillator, so the knob changes nothing
Sets the width of Castor's pulse wave: fully counter-clockwise holds it at its low level for the whole cycle, and turning up lengthens the high part until it fills the cycle
Sets the width of Pollux's pulse wave: fully counter-clockwise holds it at its low level for the whole cycle, and turning up lengthens the high part until it fills the cycle
Fades the Mix output between Castor at fully counter-clockwise and Pollux at fully clockwise; the two single-oscillator outputs are unaffected by it
Sets how much of Castor's ramp wave goes into Castor's mix
Sets how much of Castor's pulse wave goes into Castor's mix
Sets how much of Pollux's pulse wave goes into Pollux's mix
Steps through four modes: Chorus adds the modulator to Pollux's pitch, LFO PWM to both pulse widths, LFO FM to Castor's pitch, and Hard Sync resets Pollux's phase whenever Castor's wraps
Sets how much of Castor's sub-octave square goes into Castor's mix
Sets how much of Pollux's sub-octave square goes into Pollux's mix
Sets how much of Pollux's ramp wave goes into Pollux's mix
Switches the knobs to a second set of remembered values; only the modulator knob in Chorus mode and the two pulse width knobs in LFO PWM mode differ, so in LFO FM and Hard Sync nothing changes
Switches the oscillator modelling on and off, and comes up on: it turns the ramp from a straight sawtooth into a capacitor discharge curve and makes the sub-octave square sag across each half cycle

inputs.text: Added to Castor's pulse width at a fifth of the knob's travel per volt, so 5V covers the whole of it, and the total is held between the two ends of the knob
Added to Pollux's pulse width at a fifth of the knob's travel per volt; in Hard Sync mode it is read as Pollux's pitch instead, clamped to 6V either way, which is a slip in the code
Sets Castor's pitch at 1V per octave, with the Castor pitch knob added as an offset of up to one volt either way; patching anything here also stops that knob stepping in semitones
Sets Pollux's pitch at 1V per octave, and with nothing patched Pollux follows Castor's pitch; in Hard Sync mode this jack is never read

outputs.text: Castor's ramp, pulse and sub mixed by its three level knobs
Castor and Pollux mixed by the crossfade knob
Pollux's ramp, pulse and sub mixed by its three level knobs

notes: the oscillator the panel and the tooltips call an LFO runs from 64Hz to 2048Hz, so Chorus, LFO PWM and LFO FM are all audio-rate modulation rather than slow movement
the module is monophonic: each input is read as one channel and each output carries one channel
the knobs are read once every 128 samples, and changing the mode knob or the alt button snaps every other knob to the value remembered for the new setting
in Chorus mode the modulator knob works the other way round from its tooltip: with the alt button off it sets the depth, and the rate comes from where it was left with the alt button on
with the modelling switch on, each of the six waves also passes through a one-pole low-pass and a one-pole high-pass before it reaches the mix

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
inputs.2:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 1V per octave.
inputs.3:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads Castor's pitch; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 1V per octave.
